Version 1.64 Now Available!
Next Update December 1st! Adding Amsterdam Schiphol!
notes.notes:
http://www.bigfatsimulations.com/imageHost/schiphol.jpg

Hi folks!  Although I'm hard at work on the 3D version of Airport Madness for January, I fully intend to continue maintaining and expanding Airport Madness: World Edition.  The next update comes on December 1st, and will add Amsterdam Schiphol airport.  I also plan to fix many game bugs.

notes.title: Major Updates Since Release
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Airport Madness: World Edition!  Since our May 28 release, we've made major changes, most notably the addition of Barcelona Airport, Spain.  We've also:


    Added several achievements
    Added trading cards
    Added clouds
 Added aircraft data tags
 Enlarged the viewing space to full-screen
 Added an Options page
 Did we mention the addition of Barcelona Airport?
 

If you haven't downloaded Airport Madness: World Edition yet, it's on sale at 25% off until August 10th, 2015!

Barcelona Airport:

http://www.bigfatsimulations.com/imageHost/barcelona.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.33 Available
notes.notes:
We've added 26 Steam achievements!  We'd like to bring you even more, so please give us your ideas!  

We've also added a full-screen toggle button, so players can go back-and-forth between viewing options.

We're hoping to add trading cards very soon!
